import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=np.asarray(t);P=np.asarray(P);y=np.asarray(dP_dt)
def model(p,t,P,form):
    w=p[0]
    X=[t,np.sin(w*t)/P]+form
    return X
forms={'Plog,t/P':lambda P,t:[P*np.log(P),t/P],
       'Plog,P2':lambda P,t:[P*np.log(P),P**2],
       'Plog,tP':lambda P,t:[P*np.log(P),t*P],
       'P,t/P':lambda P,t:[P,t/P]}
for k,f in forms.items():
    def r(p):
        X=np.column_stack(model(p,t,P,f(P,t)))
        c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]
        return X@c-y
    best=None
    for w0 in [0.3,0.41,0.5,1.0,2.0]:
        s=least_squares(r,[w0])
        if best is None or s.cost<best.cost: best=s
    X=np.column_stack(model(best.x,t,P,f(P,t)))
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]
    print(k, best.x, c, np.mean((X@c-y)**2)/np.var(y))
